_help: See README.md. profile_dir keeps you logged in (git-ignored). Keep headless false.

send._help: Feature 1. Each job = one .txt file, one line = one message sent as 'line + newline + text'. delay = seconds between messages.

collect._help: Features 2+3. senders: names OR numbers exactly as WhatsApp shows them (run `python wa.py read --chat GROUP` to see). Numbers match on digits only, names case-insensitive. Empty list = everyone.

sheets._help: mode: gspread (Google Sheets via service_account.json) or csv (local file).

bot._help: Command bot (python bot.py). group = WhatsApp group where you type /start … . headless=true = no window. ignore_own=true when the bot runs on ITS OWN number (recommended): it never treats its own/outgoing messages as commands. Set false only if bot + commands are the same number.
